title: FBI 'image cheapening' of Jean Seberg

tellings.quote: the context in which image cheapening is has been used or famously against a woman who was a leading actress in hollywood named jean seberg and the fbi is how we learned about image cheapening planted a story with a woman named joyce haber in the los angeles times that the baby that she was carrying was in fact not her french husbands but was in fact the baby of a black panther

plain: The FBI is said to have used a tactic called "image cheapening" against the Hollywood actress Jean Seberg around 1970. It planted a story with the Los Angeles Times columnist Joyce Haber claiming that the baby Seberg was carrying was not her French husband's but a Black Panther's. The researcher Eric Weinstein tells this on the show without naming a source, as the well-known case through which the public learned the term, and his point is that agencies have smeared people on purpose to discredit them.
